text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Make the world marvelous!"—With that 
singular goal in her heart, Marvelous 
Sunday keeps running today.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Post time is approaching fast at Hanshin 
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the Umamusume are making their way 
onto the course one after another!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The undisputed race favorite is none other 
than the Arima Kinen champion, Marvelous 
Sunday!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Immense attention gathers on the showdown 
with Mayano Top Gun and Sakura Laurel, 
both celebrated as part of the Big Three!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: And furthermore—!!
—Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fujiiiiii! Fuji, Fuji, Fuji-chan!☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I can run again! We can run together 
again! Again and again, as many times as 
it takes! A growing, ever-expanding 
Marvelooouuus☆★"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm so happy! To think I'd get to 
hear that from the champion of the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Though of course, I do believe I've become 
'even more Marvelous.'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Enough to leave you completely 
astonished, of course! Now... shall we 
begin?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes, Marvelouuuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday keeps running. And I will 
keep supporting her right by her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened on one such day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting to wander, walking on and on, she 
finally reached a scenic hill and quietly 
gazed out into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Staring—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Staring intently—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a long, long, long time—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad to be alive.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's why... I really wanna live.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She quietly murmured to herself.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer!! We've made so many things 
marvelous together up till now!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was surprised. They were 
laughing. They looked like they were 
having so much fun!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Still, everyone surely goes through a lot 
of pain and hardship, too, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I might not fully understand, but I get 
it! Those dark days you went through.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How my chest wouldn't expand no matter how 
much air I took in. How agonizing, faint, 
and frail my heartbeat was. How I couldn't 
move my legs the way I wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure everyone hurts somewhere. I'm 
sure everyone suffers at some point."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even so, —

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even so, everyone smiled for us!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why the world is Marvelous!! That's 
why everyone is Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's what they said, everyone, all of 
them too—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You made me realize it!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I've told you stories about way back when, 
right? Do you remember? About when I was 
little.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
About the time when I thought... I might 
never open my eyes again.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I told you I ran toward the light, right? 
The truth is, you see—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Running was so, so tough!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With every step, my legs were screaming, I 
couldn't breathe, and everything went 
black before my eyes! It was so painful, 
so hard, so agonizing—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even so!! I'm so glad I didn't quit 
running!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to be alive!! I'm so glad to 
be alive and to have met you!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Because thanks to you, it's so... so, so, 
MARVELOUS☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —That's why, come on, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, she leaped into my arms. 
This time, I embraced her back without 
hesitation. —So that I could envelop her 
in light.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's live! Let's keep living 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Live, run, and enjoy it all! Sing praise 
to miracles, wonders, and joy!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: This world—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "‘Marveeelously’☆★☆"
